column3: The composer card grid uses UI SDK's ui-file-input list for keys; Solid draws each card into the item the SDK made from its template, and removal has no exit animation
column4: Letting Solid own the items raced the SDK's own rendering (it created bare items before the value arrived); mounting into the SDK's items keeps one owner for the DOM. Instant removal suits a keyboard run of deletes (emil-design-eng) and lets the SDK move focus to the neighbour
